findings.title: Release content-hash output is path-dependent and not portable across checkouts
findings.description: The revised command correctly excludes the generated hash manifest, but it sorts by FullName and writes path=$_.FullName. The resulting evidence therefore contains absolute machine-specific checkout paths.
findings.impact: Byte-identical source trees in different workspace paths produce different content-hashes.json output, weakening portability and release reproducibility and potentially exposing local path or user information.
findings.requiredRemediation: Hash resolved full paths but sort and serialize consistently normalised repository- or case-relative paths.

verdictRationale: One unresolved MAJOR correctness finding remains because the release content-hash output is tied to the local absolute checkout path.
requiredActions: AFF-4 must serialize stable normalised relative paths while hashing resolved full paths.
Regenerate the affected candidate artifacts and canonical manifest.
